design_timing: Designed after the published single-map ranking failure was known, before seeing any new tile-placement output. The single-map rendering is descriptive, not a new blind validation.
targets: Both source-author row-centre annotations in the existing inventory; coarse boxes, never ink or letter truth
fixed_context_width: Entire reference field; retain the same physical scale in full-field and row panels, without stretching a smaller crop
display: Unchanged supplied [0,1] scale; preview reduction only; missing support is purple; row strips have no proposal overlays
ranking: Unchanged line_review.Config defaults; source targets are not supplied to rank_map
comparison_mask: Intersection of supplied validity masks, used identically for both rankings and all coverage calculations
coverage: Union of original-grid band polygons at each K; supported target area and horizontal centreline coverage, plus fraction of the whole source target actually observed
row_rank_descriptions: First proposal with any observed centreline overlap (one pixel is sufficient; not evidence of a line)
First individual proposal covering at least half the observed source centreline
Rank of the proposal with greatest observed centreline overlap, choosing the earlier rank in a tie
All individual proposal overlaps, without selecting one favourable summary
pair_contract: Same reference field, model, depth/order, preprocessing, fusion, tile shape and stride; different declared tile-origin residues. This checks declared metadata, not the physical authenticity of a rerun.
excluded_claims: Glyph recognition or a count of legible letters
A false-positive rate or a new candidate gate
An image translation as a tile-placement experiment
An empirical tile-placement result without two actually computed model outputs
